spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  month as time, median_bias
FROM
  "Monthly_R_R"
WHERE
  product_1='$product_1'
  AND product_2='$product_2'
  AND (radar_1='$radar_1' OR radar_1 IS NULL)
  AND (radar_2='$radar_2' OR radar_2 IS NULL)
  AND ABS(min_availability-$min_availability)<0.0001
  AND ABS(min_precip_rate-$min_precip_rates)<0.0001
  ORDER BY month
